If you only have space for seated VR or if you only want to play simulators the Rift has advantages over the Vive in audio quality and headset balance.

For me though exploring the worlds and being able to reach out to interact with the world is what I wanted for consumer VR. The consumer Rift just feels like a really polished DK2 and the xbone controller is extremely disappointing.
